chars.ff797ec4-8d7e-cab1-656e-896ae3ed005f: The Beastman’s massively shaggy hide acts as Armour, deflecting sword strokes and protecting him from harm. The model gains a 6+ Armour Save that can be combined with other Armour as normal

modifiers.value: To promote a henchmen to hero, duplicate the group. Set one group to 1 promoted model and decrease the size of the remaining henchmen group by 1.
